_about: Measured GUI geometry for tools/lvclick.py. Per machine: LabVIEW 2026, Windows 10, 1920x1080, 100% DPI, default toolbar, diagram at actual size (Ctrl+0), scroll origin (0,0). Offsets are screen pixels. Re-measure on any other setup; unknown entries make verbs refuse and escalate to the vision executor, which records what it found here.

viewport._note: screen = diagram + (rect.left + dx, rect.top + dy); measured 2026-09-04 with BD rect (0,4)-(1400,904): screen = diagram + (11,41). calibrate() verifies with TWO objects (scale exactly 1, same offset) before any click.

classes._note: header_rgb = solid fill of the node's header row (probed 2026-09-05); grab = (fraction of width, px from top) for dragging; size = (w,h) px at actual size. The grab pixel must probe as header_rgb before a drag is issued.

palette._note: Functions palette opened by right-click on empty canvas. Offsets are relative to the POPUP WINDOW rect's top-left once 'rel' is 'popup'; entries still marked rel 'rclick' are relative to the right-click point P and are converted to popup-relative automatically the first time the popup rect is observed.
palette._drop_note: palette drops the icon centred on the click; report() gives the top-left of a ~16x16 icon

menus._note: context menu opened by right-click at point Q (a node's item row centre); item offset from Q. Each item names its verifier: the verb refuses items without one.

Change To Write._note: on a read-only property row (e.g. Control Position read) the VI breaks: ExecState 1->0

Terminal._note: context menu of a subVI/node TERMINAL (right-click exactly on the terminal): 'Create' at +41,+48 opens a submenu whose 'Control' is at +255,+67 from the right-click point (measured 2026-09-06 on Create Property Node.vi's Properties terminal at screen 919,676; menu top-left ~ (921,583))

dialogs._note: button offset from the dialog window rect's top-left; size is checked (+-3 px) before clicking, recorded on first use if null

Find._measured: 2026-09-05 vision fallback: Cancel button centre at (225,400) of the 452x430 dialog; the old (484,466) was outside the dialog

calibration_objects._note: two well-separated top-level objects used by calibrate() on this VI: class, uid

_canvas_note: diagram point that is empty on GUIBENCH_v0; used by focus_bd to absorb the swallowed first mouse-down
